analytics.name: Analytic 1888
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies successful authentication to an Industrial Control System (ICS) application such as a Human-Machine Interface (HMI), historian, Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) server using credentials matching known default vendor passwords, from a logon source not associated with any authorized user. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.
